name: tbc-camera-manager
description: TBC is a modular, Docker-based camera manager. Camera vendors are integrated through installable camera modules. Reolink, Aqara, TP-Link/Tapo, Axis, Foscam, Hikvision, Dahua (including Amcrest/Annke OEM devices), Ubiquiti/UniFi Protect, and SONOFF are available as directly installable standard repositories.
